predecessors.name: Gupta Empire
predecessors.text: West Bengal and Bangladesh as Cliopatria's Maukhari shape holds them; the Maukhari page limits that kingdom to Nalanda in the east

successors.name: Kamarupa
successors.text: Karnasuvarna, which Bhaskaravarman 'even managed to conquer'

successors.name: Harsha's Empire (Pushyabhuti dynasty)
successors.text: 'Gauda was soon divided amongst Harshavardhana and Bhaskarvarmana of Kamarupa'

ledger.x: 554: the Gauda kingdom stands in Bengal.
602: Shashanka sweeps out the Later Guptas.
Undated: Shashanka extends his kingdom into Odisha.

wars.name: Shashanka's attack on Kannauj and the killing of Rajyavardhana
wars.outcome: 'c. 606 C.E. Rajyavardhana was killed by Shashanka' (no conclusive evidence); the Maukhari king Grahavarman was killed by Devagupta of Malwa c. 605; Harsha, ruler of Thanesar in 606, then attacked Kannauj. No land stayed with Gauda.

wars.name: Shashanka's wars with Harsha and Kamarupa
wars.outcome: Attacks on Kamarupa 'between 595 and 600 C.E.'; Shashanka 'continued to rule Gauda with frequent attacks from Harsha' and defended Vanga and Samatata against him (undated).

certainty.note: The pages describe a domain 'from Vanga to Bhuvanesha' bordering Kamarupa and give no border line.
